# ARC-1 documentation

> Use the documentation from the source revision used to build the deployed artifact.
> The website and raw source below follow main and may describe unreleased changes.

## Start with the task

- [Start here](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/): choose a local connection, shared deployment, or existing-server workflow.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/quickstart/): connect a local client and verify a read.
- [Use a connected assistant](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/mcp-usage/): read, check, and change objects.
- [Install in Claude](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/install-in-claude/): configure Claude Code or Desktop.
- [Agent plugin](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/agent-plugin/): install the server with task skills.
- [Tool reference](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/tools/): choose a tool, then read its focused reference.
- [Configuration](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/configuration-reference/): find flags, defaults, and limits.
- [Operations](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/operations/): update, diagnose, or administer an existing server.

## SAP BTP setup and administration

- [BTP Start Here](https://docs.arc-1-mcp.com/btp-overview/): choose the topology, then follow its deployment or administration links.

In a local checkout, read docs_page/btp-overview.md instead. Without a checkout, the
[raw Markdown on main](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arc-mcp/arc-1/main/docs_page/btp-overview.md)
is also available.

Use the same revision for linked guides and examples. Research and plans are not shipped settings.
Ask for missing landscape inputs, not passwords, tokens, private keys or raw service bindings.
